data.description:
OBJECTS
Objects is an interactive module designed to offer a range of hands-on activities that encourage creativity and play. Users can stack blocks, or hit a ball with a ping pong racquet, all within a calming virtual environment.

HOOPS
Promotes hand-eye coordination by requiring precise aiming and throwing motions. In this virtual environment, players throw coloured basketballs into the corresponding hoops, with a countdown timer driving the action.

SLINGSHOT
This activity enhances hand-eye coordination and precision as they aim and shoot at the moving targets where users are challenged to pop rising balloons using a sling and small balls. The game adds an element of fun and precision as players aim at the moving targets.

3D PAINTING
Painting offers patients a peaceful and creative escape allowing them to express themselves through virtual art in a soothing environment. With calming instrumental music playing in the background, this interact provides a serene space for relaxation and artistic exploration.

WORDSEARCH
Word Search brings the classic puzzle into a virtual reality setting, offering patients an immersive way to engage their minds. Players search for hidden words in a grid, using intuitive hand gestures to select them.

MUSIC BOXING
Engaging in music boxing in a virtual gym area enhances hand-eye coordination and motor skills through rhythm-based punching actions.

changelog.change_log:
WELCOME TO HEALTHVR

Gamified interactions designed to help with distraction and mild interactive and physical interact experiences designed specifically to be simple and can be used controller free, so patients are able to use them with ease sitting down, standing or within confined areas such as waiting rooms, post operative spaces and clinical facilities. 

Our six interact experiences are designed in a way that patients can use features such as painting, word search or work on their hoops, darts or slingshot skills We also have mild physical activities such as music boxing and interacting with objects in VR space helping with their dexterity and motor skills. These activities are calming, relaxing and joyful. 

All activities work offline.
